title: Overcoming Shortcut Learning in Graph Neural Networks through Active Explanation Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2608.14121v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can solve prediction tasks by unintentionally exploiting shortcuts---that is, edges, nodes, and features that correlate with but are not causal for the prediction---which compromise their reliability in out-of-distribution tasks. We introduce XIGL, an architecture-agnostic human-in-the-loop strategy for removing such shortcuts from GNNs. Our key insight is twofold. On the one hand, reliance on shortcuts can be detected by inspecting GNN explanations. On the other hand, once made aware of such shortcuts, sufficiently expert users can provide tailored corrective feedback, which helps deconfound the model. XIGL supports any query strategy; however, since corrective feedback can be expensive to acquire, we develop an active learning strategy for prioritizing explanations that are more likely to display shortcut behavior, lowering annotation and cognitive costs. translated_title: 通过主动解释引导克服图神经网络中的捷径学习
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNNs）可能通过无意中利用捷径（即与预测相关但非因果的边、节点和特征）来解决预测任务，这损害了它们在分布外任务中的可靠性。我们引入了XIGL，一种与架构无关的人机回环策略，用于从GNNs中移除此类捷径。我们的关键见解有两个方面。一方面，通过检查GNN解释可以检测对捷径的依赖。另一方面，一旦用户意识到此类捷径，足够专业的用户可以提供量身定制的纠正性反馈，这有助于消除模型的混淆。XIGL支持任何查询策略；然而，由于获取纠正性反馈可能成本高昂，我们开发了一种主动学习策略，用于优先处理更可能展示捷径行为的解释，从而降低标注和认知成本。我们展示了XIGL的有效性，包括b（截断部分）。
tldr: XIGL是一种人机回环主动解释引导方法，通过检测并纠正图神经网络中的捷径学习，提升模型在分布外任务中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: XIGL is a human-in-the-loop active explanation guidance method that detects and corrects shortcut learning in graph neural networks, enhancing reliability in out-of-distribution tasks.
